summary: Nippon Ichi Software's long-running Netherworld tactical RPG series, including the numbered games, direct sequel D2, Prinny action spinoffs, and historical mobile/service entries.

entries.title: Disgaea: Hour of Darkness

emulation.emulator: Native PS4/Switch capture; PC native for Disgaea PC; PCSX2/PPSSPP/DS emulator only for history
emulation.notes: Use the official HD release for the main run.

primary.why: Disgaea 1 Complete is the HD remake route, based on the enhanced releases and updated with higher-resolution sprites and later-series art/class updates.
primary.how_to_play: Play Disgaea 1 Complete on PS4 or Switch for an official HD capture route; use Disgaea PC only if a PC-native setup is required.

entries.remaster_caveats: Disgaea PC is the PC-native option, but the Complete release is the HD remake route.

entries.title: Disgaea 2: Cursed Memories

emulation.emulator: Native PC; PCSX2 or PPSSPP only for comparison
emulation.notes: Use the PC version for the main run.

primary.why: Disgaea 2 PC includes the PS2 and PSP content, including Dark Hero Days material and DLC characters, with PC-native capture.
primary.how_to_play: Play Disgaea 2 PC through Steam on a modern computer; use the PS2 or PSP versions only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate HD Complete release documented; PC is the best bundled-content route.

entries.title: Disgaea 3: Absence of Justice

emulation.emulator: Vita3K for testing; Vita/PlayStation TV for dependable capture
emulation.notes: Verify Vita3K compatibility before a full stream.

primary.why: The Vita rerelease is the enhanced remaster of Disgaea 3 and is the most complete official route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a Vita or PlayStation TV capture setup, or verify Vita3K compatibility with legally dumped files before relying on emulation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC or modern-console Complete release is documented.

entries.title: Disgaea 4: A Promise Unforgotten

emulation.notes: Use the PC Complete+ release for the main run.

primary.why: Disgaea 4 Complete+ is the modern complete release on PC, PS4, and Switch; Windows gives the best capture and display-control route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Disgaea 4 Complete+ on Steam with current patches; use Vita or PS3 only for version-history comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile releases exist, but PC is the cleanest stream route.

entries.title: Disgaea D2: A Brighter Darkness

emulation.emulator: RPCS3 for testing; PS3 hardware for dependable capture
emulation.notes: Verify RPCS3 compatibility and performance before relying on emulation.

primary.why: Disgaea D2 is documented as a PlayStation 3-only direct sequel to the first game, with no PC or modern rerelease.
primary.how_to_play: Use PS3 hardware capture or RPCS3 with a legally dumped disc/image after verifying compatibility.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster or PC port documented.

entries.title: Disgaea 5: Alliance of Vengeance

emulation.notes: Use the PC Complete release for the main single-player run.

primary.why: Disgaea 5 Complete includes the PS4 DLC content and Windows offers the strongest capture and display-control route, despite the PC version lacking network compatibility.
primary.how_to_play: Play Disgaea 5 Complete on Steam; use Switch only if portable/console play is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: PC version lacks network compatibility; use Switch/PS4 only if that matters for a specific segment.

entries.title: Disgaea 6: Defiance of Destiny

emulation.notes: Use the PC Complete release for the main run.

primary.why: Disgaea 6 Complete bundles the DLC-era release onto PC, PS4, and PS5; Windows is the best capture and settings route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Disgaea 6 Complete on Steam with current patches.

entries.remaster_caveats: This entry moved the series to 3D models; no separate later remaster documented.

entries.title: Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless

emulation.notes: Use PC and install desired DLC before the run.

primary.version: Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless with DLC installed
primary.why: Disgaea 7 released on PC, Switch, PS4, and PS5; the Windows release is the highest-fidelity capture route, with DLC installable to match Complete-style content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on Windows and install desired DLC before the main run; use Switch 2 Complete only if the bundled Complete package matters more than PC capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Disgaea 7 Complete exists as a later package; verify DLC parity before finalizing a long playthrough plan.

emulation.notes: Feature-phone service/client preservation is not a normal emulator route.

primary.why: Mugen Keitai Disgaea is documented as a Japan-only mobile-phone Disgaea spinoff released in 2004.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as a historical mobile entry unless a legal preserved client route is documented; do not plan a normal stream playthrough.

entries.title: Makai Kingdom: Chronicles of the Sacred Tome

emulation.notes: Use Steam for the main run.

primary.why: Reclaimed and Rebound brings the enhanced PSP content, including Petta Mode, to PC and Switch; Windows is the best fidelity and capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Makai Kingdom: Reclaimed and Rebound on Steam; use the PS2 or PSP versions only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern release derives from earlier enhanced content rather than a full remake.

entries.title: Prinny: Can I Really Be the Hero?

emulation.emulator: Native Switch; PPSSPP for original comparison
emulation.notes: Use Switch capture for the main run.

primary.why: The Switch rerelease is the modern official route for the PSP Disgaea action spinoff.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Switch rerelease for clean modern capture; use PSP/PPSSPP only for original-version comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern rerelease of PSP-era games, not a ground-up remake.

entries.title: Disgaea Infinite

entries.title: Disgaea: Netherworld Unbound

emulation.notes: Mobile service/client preservation is not a normal emulator route.

primary.why: Netherworld Unbound is documented as a Japan-only Android spinoff based on the first game's Item World, with planned localization canceled.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as a historical mobile/service entry unless a legal preserved client route is documented; do not plan a normal stream playthrough.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern rerelease documented; North American localization plans were canceled.

entries.title: Disgaea RPG

emulation.notes: Service dependency is the limiting factor.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Mobile or PC client output while service is available.

primary.why: Disgaea RPG launched on mobile and later had an English Windows/Steam client, but the international/global service shut down in May 2023.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as a historical service-game entry unless a current official regional server and legal client route are verified immediately before coverage.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service/gacha game; verify current official server status before any coverage.

entries.title: Disgaea Mayhem

emulation.emulator: Native PS5 now; native Windows after release
emulation.notes: Re-check at western launch before a long playthrough.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS5 output now; likely native PC output after July 23, 2026.

primary.version: Makaism: Frenzy of the Netherworld / Disgaea Mayhem
primary.why: As of June 22, 2026, the action-RPG spinoff has released in Japan/Asia and is dated for a July 23, 2026 western PC/PS5/Switch/Switch 2 launch; PS5 is the current high-fidelity official route before the western PC release.
primary.how_to_play: For immediate coverage, use the Japanese/Asian PS5 release if available; otherwise wait for the July 23, 2026 western PC release, which may become the better capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: New action-RPG spinoff rather than a tactical RPG; revisit after the western PC launch.
